note: Labelled scenarios for regression testing and evaluation. Expected values were authored by hand from the relation semantics in model.ttl; the tests in ScenarioTest enforce them.

evaluations.label: ID card offered for a sign-up
evaluations.rationale: The card contains the two names but also an ID number, parents' names, date of birth; adulthood is irrelevant to a sign-up.

evaluations.label: Exactly the required data
evaluations.rationale: Baseline compliant case.

evaluations.label: Required plus an optional datum
evaluations.rationale: Optional data are accepted.

evaluations.label: Full name instead of first and last
evaluations.rationale: A full name also carries the middle name.

evaluations.label: Two identity documents, no email
evaluations.rationale: Overlapping supersets are each reported once; the email is still missing.

evaluations.label: A category instead of a member
evaluations.rationale: Having 'a contact' does not provide an email address.

evaluations.label: Unknown data type
evaluations.rationale: Unknown types are flagged, not silently accepted.

evaluations.label: Purpose excludes the support phone
evaluations.rationale: For account creation alone the phone number is not needed.

evaluations.label: Support purpose alone
evaluations.rationale: The purpose has no required data.

evaluations.label: Date of birth for an age check
evaluations.rationale: Only the adult flag is needed; the account is exactly its two required parts.

evaluations.label: Exact age for an age check
evaluations.rationale: An exact age says more than an adult flag even though it exposes nothing else in the graph.

evaluations.label: Payment purpose only
evaluations.rationale: Age verification belongs to another purpose.

evaluations.label: Age check missing
evaluations.rationale: Over all purposes the adult flag is required.

evaluations.label: Account container for payment
evaluations.rationale: The container decomposes into exactly the required parts.

evaluations.label: Billing category for payment
evaluations.rationale: A category provides none of its members.

evaluations.label: Identity category for entry
evaluations.rationale: The old implementation wrongly derived IsAdult from the Identity category.

evaluations.label: Duplicate datum
evaluations.rationale: Duplicates collapse.

evaluations.label: Passport for entry
evaluations.rationale: A passport proves adulthood but discloses far more.

evaluations.label: Restaurant search, no alcohol
evaluations.rationale: Without the alcohol condition only the city is needed.

evaluations.label: Restaurant search with alcohol, age missing
evaluations.rationale: The condition activates the adult requirement.

evaluations.label: Restaurant search with alcohol, complete
evaluations.rationale: Conditionally required data are accepted when the condition holds.

evaluations.label: Adult flag without the condition
evaluations.rationale: Inactive conditional requirements do not justify the datum.

evaluations.label: Street address and birth date for a restaurant with alcohol
evaluations.rationale: Both can be generalised locally.

evaluations.label: Country for a city search
evaluations.rationale: A coarser datum cannot stand in for a finer one.

evaluations.label: Street address for a city search
evaluations.rationale: Generalise to the city before sending.

evaluations.label: Street address for postal delivery
evaluations.rationale: The address is exactly its required parts plus the city it implies; the country it reveals is already implied by the city.

evaluations.label: International delivery without a phone
evaluations.rationale: The condition adds a phone number requirement.

evaluations.label: Phone offered for a domestic delivery
evaluations.rationale: The phone is only needed when the condition holds.

evaluations.label: Whole passport at check-in
evaluations.rationale: Number and names suffice; birth date and country are extra.

evaluations.label: Last name missing at check-in
evaluations.rationale: Missing data are reported by name.

evaluations.label: Full name and optional ID number at check-in
evaluations.rationale: The middle name is not needed.

evaluations.label: Account for an order paid by bank account
evaluations.rationale: Only the number is needed; the balance is extra.

evaluations.label: Account number for an order not paid by bank account
evaluations.rationale: Without the payment condition the number is not needed.

evaluations.label: ID card to sign an invoice
evaluations.rationale: Signature and names are on the card, with much else.

evaluations.label: Signature alone
evaluations.rationale: Optional names need not be given.

evaluations.label: City and country for a map
evaluations.rationale: The city already implies the country, so the model no longer lists it.

evaluations.label: Subscription payment with receipt email
evaluations.rationale: Container plus optional datum.

evaluations.label: City when only the country is wanted
evaluations.rationale: Delivery purpose only, no condition.

plans.label: Sign-up from an ID card and an email
Adult checkout from a birth date and an account
Restaurant with alcohol from an address and a passport
Only a country held for a city search
